clue.text: Opera singer had failed — past it?

indicators.note: a plan that has failed has fallen apart, so the letters of the two words before it are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.walkthrough: 'failed' reads as the singer's flop, but it is the signal to rearrange the two words before it.

clue.text: At party, Billy-No-Mates loses heart before second dance

clue.text: Snag as strike inhibits falling pound's rise

clue.text: Simple girls in class entering Part One of examination

clue.text: Bag of grain at cheapest possible price?

clue.text: Bank checks mostly eliminating one selfish hoarder

clue.text: Who would have vegetable cooking?

clue.text: Decline of pound during depression
